name: snes9x (synchronous, no ASYNCIFY)
role: Real-time routing/playback. DEFAULT boot core. Paired with the bsnes-mercury cores which stay available for paused, frame-perfect sub-pixel work.
license: Non-commercial (Snes9x license); see the snes9x source LICENSE.

asyncify.why: snes9x does NOT use libco cooperative cothreads the way bsnes does, so retro_run is a normal SYNCHRONOUS call that returns each frame with NO ASYNCIFY. That is the whole performance point: real-time playback on the mobile main thread. Verified by tools/run-smoke.mjs — retro_run returns each frame synchronously and the JS loader contains zero 'asyncify' references.

verified: tools/run-smoke.mjs cores/snes9x_libretro.js 60 — ALL ASSERTIONS PASSED: retro_load_game true, retro_run returns each frame with NO hang, video_refresh non-null 256x224 RGB565, frames advance. Timing ~1.1 ms/frame (60 frames in 66 ms), vs the bsnes ASYNCIFY cores' ~73-235 ms/frame. WRAM (RETRO_MEMORY_SYSTEM_RAM) size = 131072. tools/core-probe.mjs: 17/17 raw retro_* exports + Module.addFunction present, 0/10 EmulatorJS high-level API (i.e. this is the fresh from-source raw-libretro build, NOT the old removed EmulatorJS file of the same name).
hud_memory_map: NOT YET empirically verified for snes9x. tools/hud-crosscheck.mjs (against cores/snes9x_libretro.js) shows the bsnes-verified SMB1 All-Stars offsets ($005D H-Speed, $0042/$0043/$0401 X, $0002/$041C Y) do NOT track Mario on snes9x's SYSTEM_RAM region even though the region size matches bsnes (131072) — different base/mirroring. memory-watch.js therefore uses a PER-CORE map keyed on engine.activeCoreId: bsnes rows stay proven (render clean), snes9x rows render an explicit '(unverified)' tag until snes9x's own offsets are proven. The frame counter (engine-sourced) is always correct on every core.
emscripten_flags: NO -s ASYNCIFY (synchronous retro_run — the performance win)
-s EXPORTED_FUNCTIONS=[22 raw retro_* + malloc/free; NO retro_cheat_*]
single-threaded (no pthreads / no SharedArrayBuffer) for iOS
makefile_edits: Added an 'else ifeq ($(platform), emscripten)' block to snes9x/libretro/Makefile modeled on the bsnes-mercury emscripten block but WITHOUT ASYNCIFY: CC=emcc/CXX=em++/LD=em++, fpic/LTO cleared, -fno-strict-aliasing, TARGET=snes9x_libretro.js, and the SHARED link flags above. Built with `emmake make platform=emscripten -j8`.
